card.text: Largest piece of a family that broke up 5.8 million years ago.

sources.label: Nesvorný et al. (2002), Nature 417, 720
sources.quote: As (832) Karin is the largest body in the observed population, we adopt the name ‘Karin cluster’.

introduction.text: M. Wolf found Karin at Heidelberg in 1916. It is the largest body of the Karin cluster, which formed in one break-up 5.8 million years ago.

sources.label: JPL Small-Body Database
